_source: Two live plants, 2026-11-18, local time (UTC+2). Bus 1: a BTicino 3550 99-zone central unit (#0) running zones 3 (two plain heating valves) and 4 (a heating valve and a cooling fan coil), and zone 2, a standalone thermostat (fan coil) the 3550 does not run, reached through an F461 2.0.11 and an F455 1.0.76. Bus 2: 34 standalone thermostats (zones 35 to 70, 29 heating only and 5 with a cooling fan coil), no central unit, reached through a MyHomeServer1 3.87.13 and a 3488 3.2.5 (set up in Home Assistant under the model name MyHomeServer1, which the setup form suggests). Only WHO 4 frames and the ACK / NACK ending a request, copied by script from Home Assistant debug logs and from the logs of a direct OpenWebNet client.

_traces.g3488_who4_requests: Direct client on the 3488's command session, 22:59. The general request and the central unit's status are refused (no central unit on this bus), zone 47 answers every read but its fan speed, and a zone that does not exist (1) is refused after 2.1 s.
_traces.g3488_all_zone_requests: Same client, 23:00: every actuator (*#4*0#0*20## and the older *#4*#0*20##), every humidity probe, and the zone forms for zone 49. The first eight replies of a burst come on the command session.
_traces.g3488_valve_status: Same client, 23:02: valve status (dimension 19) and actuators (dimension 20) of heating-only zones (49, 65, 59) and of zones with a cooling fan coil (47, 60, 48, 57, 70).
_traces.f461_valve_status: Direct client on the F461's command session, 23:02: valve status and actuators of zone 3 (heating only), zone 4 (heating valve and cooling fan coil) and zone 2 (fan coil, cooling).
_traces.f455_alone_blank_start: F455 Home Assistant instance started 21:01:03.862 with no climate entity in its registry and no myhome.yaml, alone on bus 1 (the F461 instance was not running). The central unit becomes known from its report about zone 3 (*4*110*#3##, 21:01:56.397), is then asked its status once (*#4*#0##) and answers (*4*102*#0##). tx: frames the instance wrote (time of the 'successfully sent' line, logged when the reply is complete); rx: its event session.
_traces.f461_blank_start: F461 Home Assistant instance started 23:22:40.967, same conditions, the F455 instance starting on the same bus at the same time (its requests' answers are on this event session too).
_traces.f455_blank_start: F455 Home Assistant instance, the same start.
_traces.myhomeserver1_blank_start: MyHomeServer1 Home Assistant instance started 23:22:41.365 with no climate entity and no myhome.yaml, the 3488 instance starting on the same bus at the same time. nack: a status request the gateway refused (*#4*#0##: no central unit; *#4*Z*11##: the fan speed of a fan coil in the heating season).
_traces.g3488_blank_start: 3488 Home Assistant instance (set up under the model name MyHomeServer1), the same start (23:22:41.382).
_traces.f461_central_off_start: F461 Home Assistant instance started 23:40:36.084 with no climate entity, the 3550 switched off (*4*103*#0##). A direct client asked the central unit's status at 23:40:49 (its answer is on this event session: the off report arrives while zone 2 exists). Zone 2 is found standalone at 23:41:10.518 and its actuators are asked again (*#4*0#0*20## at 23:41:11.739).
